name: Artists Assemble Horror Fest
blurb: Annual Halloween-season horror convention in Mesa with celebrity guests, a costume contest and trick-or-treating.
notes: The 5th annual Horror Fest (Oct 2-4, 2026) ended the day before the research window opens (2026-10-05), so it is recorded as 'last' rather than an upcoming edition. The site keeps a yearly archive (Horror Fest 2022-2026) but has not yet posted a 2027 page/link, so next-year dates are not announced.
